description: Grands barrages de Nouvelle-Calédonie is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Généalogie: Les données sont constituées des informations réglementaires transmises par les exploitants ou sont issues de constats du service de l'industrie lors des contrôles des ouvrages. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Environment, Climate. Its keywords are barrageux, ouvragesutagnc, MoissonnageGeorep. The portal shows 2026-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
